title: इन्द्र बानियाँ कहाँ छन् ? पक्राउ अनुमति पाए पनि प्रहरी मौन
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौं । नेपाली कांग्रेसका नेता तथा बागमती प्रदेशका पूर्व मुख्यमन्त्री इन्द्र बानियाँ सार्वजनिक तथा पारिवारिक सम्पर्कमा छैनन् । उनलाई पक्राउ गर्न उच्च अदालतले अनुमति दिएको छ, तर प्रहरीको कुनै पनि युनिटले उनलाई पक्राउ गरेको स्वीकार्दैन । प्रहरी उच्चस्रोतका अनुसार बानियाँलाई केन्द्रीय अनुसन्धान ब्यूरो (सीआईबी) को टोलीले खोजीरहेको छ । यसअघि उनका छोरा दीक्षान्त र भतिज ऋषि बानियाँ कर्जा दुरुपयोगको अभियोगमा पक्राउ परेका थिए । उनीहरू पक्राउ पर्नासाथ कांग्रेस नेता बानियाँ सम्पर्क बाहिर रहे । छोरा र भतिजालाई केन्द्रीय अनुसन्धान ब्यूरो (सीआईबी) ले पक्रेको थियो । तर, नेता बानियाँको खोजी वा पक्राउबारे जिज्ञासा राख्दा सीआईबीका प्रवक्ता एसएसपी अनुपमसमशेर जबराले केही बताउन चाहेनन् । सीआईबीले पक्राउ गरेका व्यक्ति लुकाउनुपर्ने वा अन्यत्र राख्नुपर्ने कुनै कारण नहुने उनको भनाइ छ । बानियाँको पारिवारिकस्रोत भने प्रहरीले काठमाडौंको छैमलेबाट पक्राउ गरेको र भृकुटीमण्डपस्थित नगर प्रहरीको हिरासतमा राखिएको दावी गर्छ । तर, नगर प्रहरीसँग पक्राउ गरिएका व्यक्तिलाई केही समय राख्नेबाहेक आवासीय हिरासत छैन । र, प्रहरीले पनि पक्राउ गरेको भनेको छैन । नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकको जाहेरीले बैंकिङ कसुर तथा सजाय ऐन, २०६४ अन्तर्गत पक्राउ गर्न उनलाई अदालतले अनुमति दिएको हो । यसअघि उनका छोरा दीक्षान्त कात्तिक १६ गते पक्राउ परेका थिए । दीक्षान्त पक्राउ परेपछि उनलाई भेट्न जाँदा भतिजा ऋषि बानियाँ पनि भोलिपल्ट पक्राउ परेका थिए । प्रहरीको केन्द्रीय अनुसन्धान ब्यूरो (सीआईबी) को टोलीले दीक्षान्तलाई रुपन्देहीको भैरहवाबाट पक्राउ गरेको थियो । पूर्व मुख्यमन्त्री बानियाँमाथि विभिन्न ४ वटा बैंकबाट ‘अन्डरग्राउन्ड सिमेन्ट कम्पनी’ को नाममा लिएको ३४ करोड रुपैयाँ कर्जा दुरुपयोग गरेको आरोप लागेको छ । पक्राउ परेका उनका छोरा र भतिजामाथि सोही कसुरमा मुद्दा चलाइएको छ । Kathmandu. Nepali Congress leader and former Chief Minister of Bagmati Province, Indra Baniya, is not in public or family contact. The High Court has allowed his arrest, but no police unit has acknowledged his arrest. According to a senior police source, Baniya is being sought by a team of the Central Bureau of Investigation (CIB). Earlier, his son Dikshant and nephew Rishi Baniya were arrested on charges of loan misuse. After their arrest, Congress leader Baniya remained out of contact. The son and nephew were arrested by the Central Bureau of Investigation (CIB). However, when asked about the search or arrest of leader Baniya, CIB spokesperson SSP Anupam Shumsher Jabra did not want to comment. He said that there is no reason to hide or keep someone arrested by the CIB elsewhere. Baniya's family sources claim that the police arrested him from Chhaimale in Kathmandu and kept him in the custody of the municipal police station in Bhrikutimandap. However, the municipal police does not have residential custody except for keeping the arrested person for a short period of time. And the police also did not say that he was arrested. The court has given permission to arrest him under the Banking Offences and Punishments Act, 2064, based on a complaint filed by Nepal Rastra Bank. Earlier, his son Dikshant was arrested on Kartik 16. After Dikshant was arrested, his nephew Rishi Baniya was also arrested the next day when he went to visit him. A team of the Central Investigation Bureau (CIB) of the police arrested Dikshant from Bhairahawa, Rupandehi. Former Chief Minister Baniya is accused of misusing loans worth Rs 340 million taken from four different banks in the name of 'Underground Cement Company'. His son and nephew, who were arrested, have been charged with the same offense.

The son and nephew were arrested by the Central Bureau of Investigation (CIB). However, when asked about the search or arrest of leader Baniya, CIB spokesperson SSP Anupam Shumsher Jabra did not want to comment. He said that there is no reason to hide or keep someone arrested by the CIB elsewhere. Baniya's family sources claim that the police arrested him from Chhaimale in Kathmandu and kept him in the custody of the municipal police station in Bhrikutimandap. The court has given permission to arrest him under the Banking Offences and Punishments Act, 2064, based on a complaint filed by Nepal Rastra Bank. Earlier, his son Dikshant was arrested on Kartik 16. After Dikshant was arrested, his nephew Rishi Baniya was also arrested the next day when he went to visit him. A team of the Central Investigation Bureau (CIB) of the police arrested Dikshant from Bhairahawa, Rupandehi.
